title: The one-time code request — question explanation
learningObjective: Never disclose a one-time password or verification code to another person
format: 16:9 educational motion-graphics video; narration; separate captions; no autoplay with sound
visualStyle: Deep navy and charcoal; restrained cyan/electric-blue highlights; limited purple accents; clean typography; purposeful, low-motion transitions; accessible contrast.

scenes.name: Scenario setup
scenes.visual: A caller claiming to be bank support says a verification code has been sent to your phone and asks you to read it aloud to stop a suspicious transaction.
scenes.direction: Show a fictional simulated setting. Use generic UI and no actual organization, brand, user identity, credential, real URL or live account.

scenes.name: Learning objective and risk cue
scenes.visual: Never disclose a one-time password or verification code to another person
scenes.direction: Highlight only observable cues and explain the decision context without implying certainty beyond the scenario.

scenes.name: Recommended response
scenes.visual: Option A: Hang up and contact the bank using the number on your card or official app; never share the code. An unsolicited caller must not receive an authenticator output; independently contact the institution.
scenes.direction: Animate the recommended defensive choice as a clear decision path. Display the action verb and trusted channel/control.

scenes.name: Why the other options fail
scenes.visual: Option B: Partial disclosure can still help an attacker complete an authentication flow. Option C: Knowing personal details does not authenticate the caller; the code may authorize an action. Option D: Changing the communication channel does not make disclosure safe.
scenes.direction: Show each unsafe alternative separately with a complete, concise reason. Do not depict operational exploitation, malicious code or credential capture.

scenes.name: Defensive takeaway
scenes.visual: End the call and contact the bank through a known official channel. Review account activity and report the attempted social engineering. An OTP is an authenticator output. Do not disclose it to callers, chat contacts or anyone else.
scenes.direction: Close with one readable takeaway and the next safe action. Keep the final frame long enough for comprehension.
scenes.onScreenText: An OTP is an authenticator output. Do not disclose it to callers, chat contacts or anyone else.
